6266.title: ACP form capacity and unsupported-response ambiguity
6266.rootCauseOneLine: ACP counts all schema properties against a shared four-question cap and sends an unsupported form as a reasonless decline; real omp cancellation wording is unverified.
6266.proposedFix: Decide larger-form support without bypassing the shared payload validator, and select protocol-compatible client-unsupported diagnostics distinct from user decline.
6266.caveats: Both clean runs reproduce the bb cap and reasonless decline. No real omp/macOS run; bb sends decline, not cancel. No PR: shared schema/protocol and product decisions exceed the simple-fix gate.
